**First, use the data to map the hashtag landscape.** Sort your results by post count and split them into high-volume, mid-volume, and niche hashtags. The broad hashtags put you in front of large audiences, mid-volume ones give a realistic shot at the top posts grid, and niche hashtags connect you to highly engaged communities. No matter whether you’re planning content or researching a topic, this approach will give you a clear, layered view of reach and opportunity.

**Second, uncover connections and overlaps.** Co-occurrence data shows which hashtags, communities, or content clusters intersect. If #pilates frequently appears with #mindfulmovement, that tells you there’s a meaningful audience overlap. You can use this insight discover adjacent topics or expand your reachh.

**Third, track trends over time.** Run this Actor monthly and compare the results. If a hashtag that was niche three months ago is now seeing rapid growth in posts-per-day, you might have spotted an emerging trend early. Getting in front of a trending hashtag before it peaks is one of the most effective ways to grow organically on Instagram.

And if you want to try a level deeper, here's a fourth option for you. You can always drill down into the creators behind the most popular or recent posts that include your hashtag, and start mapping the actual accounts driving the conversation.
